create_WER_scorer: create a WER scorer to compute word error rate between predictions and references
build_BLEU_scorer: build a SacreBLEU scorer to compute corpus BLEU score with configurable tokenizer
run_ASR_BLEU_scorer: run ASR BLEU scorer to evaluate speech output using fairseq ASR pipeline
create_Whisper_ASR_scorer: create a Whisper ASR BLEU scorer with configurable model size and preprocessing
register_quality_scorer: register a custom quality scorer class with a name for use in simuleval evaluation
